title: Leslie Kean's list of ordinary explanations

tellings.quote: This is from her book UFOs, Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record.

plain: The journalist Leslie Kean's 2010 book, UFOs: Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record, includes a list of ordinary, everyday explanations for UFO sightings. The skeptic Michael Shermer brings it up and reads from it while debating Michels. He uses it to show that even a writer sympathetic to the subject accepts that many sightings have ordinary causes.
